integrity: All scientific claims are accompanied by a proof and independent reproducible finite-rational certificate. This is a self-review, not independent human or machine validation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to cube-free positive integers and the generalized divisor-sum exponent -2; closure classification, not enumeration of all actual finite-integer values. Uses Nagura prime interval theorem and Euler products; verification script certifies finite rational steps but is not a proof of the infinite tail. Priority against every unindexed publication is not established.
title: Three components and rational densities for the reciprocal-square divisor sum on cube-free integers
